value.AR: Invoice receivables in the invoice currency
value.FX_OFFSET: Offset to the reporting valuation memorandum account
value.FX_VALUATION: Base-currency reporting valuation of a foreign source event
value.UNAPPLIED: Payment amounts held for settlement or refund

value.rule: Apply the entire designated payment before period_end (exclusive). UNAPPLIED is credit-normal. Its balance is credits minus debits. The settlement index lists every UNAPPLIED movement for the payment strictly before period_end. Unassigned deposits can be refunded via debit UNAPPLIED, credit CASH.

records.value: Local date of the source event. FX_VALUATION is a separate base-currency memorandum posting. When it has payment_id, look up the payment timestamp and amount; otherwise look up the invoice issue timestamp and total. Quotes are target units per source unit.

value.recognition: Invoice issue date for invoices; transaction date for cash receipts and settlements.
